d:
Vedanta has undergone a major demerger, separating its businesses into four new listed companies alongside the existing Vedanta Limited. But what does this mean for shareholders, and how should investors analyse the five companies after the split?
In this analysis, we cover the demerger structure, the allocation of the original cost of acquisition (COA), and whether Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG) or Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax applies when selling the new shares. We also examine the financials and key metrics of all five companies, and Vedanta’s dividend history and policy.
